discomName: Jammu Power Distribution Corporation Ltd (JPDCL, JERC)

connectionTypes.sourceNote: JERC JKL — JPDCL & KPDCL ARR and Tariff Order for FY 2025-26, Schedule 2 (Non-Domestic/Commercial Supply), metered single-phase tariff (PRIMARY, https://www.jpdcl.co.in/downloads/tariff/JPDCL_KPDCL_Tariff_Order_2025_26.pdf). Three-phase connections (load >5kW) are instead billed flat at Rs.5.85/kVAh with a fixed charge of Rs.130/kVA/month — this file uses the single-phase slab structure and fixed charge as the representative figure.

JERC JKL — JPDCL & KPDCL ARR and Tariff Order for FY 2025-26, Schedule 8 (LT Industrial Supply, LTIS-I) (PRIMARY, https://www.jpdcl.co.in/downloads/tariff/JPDCL_KPDCL_Tariff_Order_2025_26.pdf). Flat kVAh energy charge of Rs.4.20/unit regardless of consumption, with demand charge Rs.60/kVA/month; a 5% rebate applies for HT-metered connections below 100kW sanctioned load (not modelled here).

JERC JKL — JPDCL & KPDCL ARR and Tariff Order for FY 2025-26, Schedule 4 (Agricultural Supply), metered tariff, 0-10 HP tier (PRIMARY, https://www.jpdcl.co.in/downloads/tariff/JPDCL_KPDCL_Tariff_Order_2025_26.pdf). The real tariff is tiered by sanctioned HP, not by consumption: 0-10 HP = Rs.0.90/kWh (fixed Rs.20/HP/month), 11-20 HP = Rs.1.15/kWh (fixed Rs.25/HP/month), above 20 HP = Rs.6.00/kWh (fixed Rs.45/HP/month). This file uses the smallest/most common tier; the fixed charge (quoted as Rs./HP/month) is converted to Rs./kW using 1 HP = 0.746 kW.
